title: Grading scales by country
description: One row per grade band in a national or institutional grading system.

country.description: Country or region the scale belongs to.

system.description: Name of the grading system within the country.

grade.description: Grade label as written in the system.

min_percent.description: Lowest percentage mark in this band (inclusive). Null when the system has no fixed percentage cutoffs.

max_percent.description: Highest percentage mark in this band (inclusive). Null when the system has no fixed percentage cutoffs.

gpa_points.description: Grade points on the system's own point scale (4.0 GPA, 10-point CGPA, Swedish merit points). Null when not applicable.

description.description: Meaning of the grade, or its native score range for non-percentage systems.

source_url.description: Primary public source for the row.

notes.description: Caveats, variation between institutions, secondary sources.
